main_text.p: extra&um comedebat Sampson in via, & paren-Iud. 14.tibus mi ducandum communicabat: Vobis vero si indefleritcupido tam Blandientis edu-lij, cogitate vos prępete mentis ala, Terram Ifraelitican pro tempore perdiustrare; Ascen-Deut. 11.sum Jonathæ & Armigeri inter dentata petras, & fugain Philistæorum modo conspexisse, aut divisse præcigitem Saulis adiutorium, & de-fecimus & Vaiuatuo populi sortem indolere, de quo quid ulterius expectandum delineat. Textus, Ingressus est itaq; populus saltum, & apparuit fluens mel: Lassis & Famelicis non segnis ad incscandum Illecebra, de quâ primo in loco aliquid est dicendum.t bos

page.notes: Printed page number at the foot right reads 69; the top right mark "5:" is a stray mark, not a page number. The catchword at the foot right is faint; "tu[?]" is uncertain. The margin note beside "illecebra" ("t bos") is very faint and may be incomplete. The Greek phrase and Hebrew words are not fully legible at this scan resolution. The top-right note beside line 1 may read differently. Signature "A 3" is clear. Several words in the text are uncertain, including "Vobis si indefleritcupido", "Vaiuatuo", "perdiustrare", and "fluens mel". Printed spelling is kept.
